reviews.text: The ladies were so kind and helpful. I have an Australian Shepard and he was so happy to stay at Can’s Chill Out!!! Thank you for the great care! 😊💕

Due to a family emergency, we had to leave him there for three days. It was a very good experience. Seila took wonderful care of our pet Calvin, whom we hadn't been separated from for seven years. He returned very well cared for and very well-behaved. Thank you so much.

A personal and friendly experience; my dog ​​was very calm when he came back to me after a few days, and I know he was happy surrounded by new friends 🐶🐶🐶 100% recommended ❣️ Thank you for taking care of Papi 🤍🖤 …
The best care and attention for my dog. I hope I can always count on this place 🤍 I would give it 10 stars. …
Bowie and Lluna were absolutely delighted. They were relaxed from the very first minute, and we were thrilled! A fantastic experience and a wonderful team of professionals 😍 …

Our dog has been going with them for a month now, and we couldn't be happier. The change has been incredible in just a few weeks. Before, he was much more wary of other dogs and people (he would bark, growl, or get scared), and now when we walk him, he's so much calmer, sniffs around, and isn't scared at all... 10/10 for them! They've brought us so much peace of mind. 😍😍😍
Very kind and professional. You can tell they love animals.
She was recommended to me and it was a great choice. My dogs and I are delighted with Seila. Thank you for your professionalism, dedication, and love for animals.

My dog ​​Bola adores Seila. Every time we go for a walk, she wants to stop and say hello, and that gives me a lot of peace of mind because I know Bola has a great time at Cans Chillout.

Thank you so much, friend!

We were very happy to find this dog day care in Lavapiés! It made it much easier for us to visit museums, the communication was excellent, and our dog was happy when we picked him up. We would highly recommend it! 🐾✨ …

I'm absolutely delighted with Seila and her doggy daycare. I've been taking my Lord Byron there since he was a tiny puppy, and thanks to Seila's training and care, he's now a fully socialized and happy adult dog.

It's a daycare where I feel 100% confident he'll be in the best possible care. Love, attention, and the place is always spotless. In short, it's wonderful!
A lifesaver for those of us with fur babies who work and need a trustworthy place and person.

And now, they even offer bathing services for clients. I couldn't ask for more! Thank you so much, Seila!

Our dog Lana has been going to the doggy daycare a couple of days a week for a year now while we work, and we're very happy with the care she receives. We have peace of mind knowing that she enjoys the day with other dogs, improves her socialization skills, and goes for walks in the park :)

Seila, the doggy daycare manager, is very friendly and always flexible so that the service can be tailored to our needs as much as possible.

100% peace of mind for the humans and 100% happiness for the dogs, at a very reasonable price. I highly recommend it!

It's the perfect place to leave my dog when I can't take her with me. The atmosphere is professional, caring, and the dogs are clearly delighted. Seila is wonderful and very knowledgeable about dog care and behavior.

I've been taking my Selva to this doggy daycare for several months now, and she arrives happier and leaves better each time. Being a timid and fearful dog, Seila has done a fantastic job with her, and I feel completely at ease when I leave her in their care. She has a great time with her friends and chilling on the cushions, hehe 💕 …

Through Can's Chill Out Daycare, I got Isabel Luengo's contact information. She looked after my 6-year-old cat at her home for a week, sending daily video calls and always being incredibly attentive.

I highly recommend this pet sitter!! 🥹🥹🥹 She gave me peace of mind throughout my entire vacation.
Contact via Telegram! Isaluengo

We had to leave Zeus for almost a month because his owner was hospitalized. Calls, photos, videos—we were always kept informed about how the dog was doing. His caregiver, Seila, is wonderful, and Zeus seemed delighted to be with the other dogs and Seila. The best doggy daycare in Madrid, by far. Thank you so much for everything.
Sheyla is a true professional. She treated our older dog with great care. We felt very at ease while she was in her care.
I wish there were more places like this!! I'd love to have one in Murcia!! I'd take my three little ones 🥰 …

The perfect doggy daycare! We've been taking our dachshund, Ramen, twice a week since he was just 4 months old, and from the very beginning, Seila has been advising and helping us train him so that he gradually improves his behavior, especially with his anxiety. Ramen always comes home happy and eager to return! Taking him to Can's Chill Out has made him a super sociable dog with other dogs! I recommend it 100%!

We've left our dog Luni with Seila a few times and we're always very happy with the daycare! Everything was perfect and our dog comes back very happy after playing and spending the day there. Thank you and see you next time :)
Our two older dogs have been wonderful. We love Seyla, and they love her too. Highly recommended; we feel very relaxed while they're there.

We left our dogs at the doggy daycare for several hours because of work, and everything was great. Excellent service and friendliness; you can tell when someone is passionate about what they do. Highly recommended.

Sheila and Juan are fantastic! The best dog sitters I know in all of Madrid. Their professionalism and love for animals are evident from the very first moment. If you ever need to leave your dog with someone, choose Sheila and Juan! 1000% recommended ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I've been taking my dog ​​there for a couple of years now, and it was the best decision I could have made.
They treat the dogs wonderfully and are incredibly committed to their well-being.
The best sign is that every time my dog ​​passes by the door, he wants to go in.
100% recommended
Excellent service, patience, and dedication. Excellent work, an achievement that will be cherished. Never seen before. My congratulations and I am extremely satisfied.
Sheila and Juan are wonderful. My dog ​​is happy with the daycare and the walks. Highly recommended.
Thank you so much, Lucia!! :)

The best doggy daycare in Madrid! I always leave my dog ​​there when I have a long day at work, and he's happy to go; he feels right at home. They even have a pool to cool off in the summer for dogs who love the water. They also offer training services with a focus on respect and the dog's well-being. I always recommend them.
Fantastic. They treat dogs well, it's clean, Seila and Juan are truly professional, my dog ​​loves them, and their flexible hours make our daily lives much easier. Highly recommended.
It was such a stroke of luck to find this dog daycare to help us with Gordi, who couldn't stand almost any other dogs, but he's become much more sociable now. Thank you so much, Seila and Juan!
